hypothesis: A prior-session primary-market exposure transfer in UPRO/SPXU that agrees with fresh SPY Arca opening-auction pressure identifies persistent cross-market risk transfer during the first cash-session hour.

signal.source_day_fund_flow_dollars: current NAV times split-adjusted current shares outstanding minus expected shares based on prior session
signal.directional_flow_dollars: UPRO flow dollars minus SPXU flow dollars
signal.availability: one US trading session after the source date
signal.auction_message: latest eligible SPY ARCX auction_type M message with ts_event strictly before 09:29:00 America/New_York
signal.auction_eligibility: positive ref_price and ind_match_price, positive paired_qty and total_imbalance_qty, side A or B
signal.upro_action: directional_flow_dollars greater than zero and auction side B
signal.spxu_action: directional_flow_dollars less than zero and auction side A

execution.primary_feed: existing Databento ARCX.PILLAR UPRO/SPXU BBO-1m already stored in the repo
execution.independent_feed: existing Databento EQUS.MINI UPRO/SPXU BBO-1m already stored in the repo
execution.delayed_entry_stress: observed ask at exactly 09:36 ET with unchanged 10:30 exit
execution.extra_cost_stress: add one cent per share to entry and subtract one cent per share from exit
execution.position: long UPRO, long SPXU, or cash

development.holdout_lock: Do not calculate any 2024-2025 strategy or control return unless every development gate passes.

controls.flow_only: trade UPRO or SPXU from lagged directional flow every eligible session
controls.auction_only: trade UPRO on side B and SPXU on side A every eligible session
controls.failed_v34_buy_only: trade UPRO on side B and otherwise cash
controls.extra_lag_flow_alignment: replace the one-session-delayed flow with the same state delayed one additional trading session, then require auction agreement
controls.prior_spy_direction: trade UPRO when the prior adjusted SPY close-to-close return is positive and SPXU when negative

benchmark.requirement: strategy compounded ending cash must be strictly greater

forbidden_repairs: opening 2024-2025 after any failed development gate
